title: Where does the next split go?
hook: Three points share a square. Which cells need more detail?

doesNotKnow: A bucket point-region quadtree refines the overflowing cell, subject to max depth.

objective: Explain why overflowing quadtree cells refine while other cells remain coarse.
misconception: Every spatial cell must split equally deeply.

claims.text: After the root splits, which child must split again? Lower-left / Upper-right / Neither; correct lower-left.
